title: Version 0.7.2 - Glaceon and City Updates
message: Latest version: 0.7.2 0.7.2 changes Glaceon - Updated Swift, Tail Whip, Ice Shard, Freeze-Dry, Icy Wind and Icicle Spear, with improved effects and more reliable move behaviour. Favourite Pokemon - Set a favourite Pokemon from the Pokemon menu. Your favourite is also used as your city companion. City lobby - Visit the stage jukebox to choose music for trainers at the stage. - Interact with other trainers to view their profiles and open a private chat. - Improved city NPC animations and performance. Automatic city entry now adjusts for devices that may struggle to run it. Gameplay and settings - Improved Psyduck Racing's racer tracking, positions and bot behaviour. - Added graphics controls for render scale, anti-aliasing and post-processing, plus mobile frame-rate and Android refresh-rate options. - Various visual, performance and stability improvements. 0.7.1 changes This version is mainly a hotfix patch to optimize the open world lobby performance, fix some bugs and add controller support to android builds Alolan Ninetales, Zoroark and Espeon join the roster! Watch custom matches as a spectator, explore a new social city lobby, and try out an expanded selection of held and battle items. New Pokemon - Alolan Ninetales joins the battle. - Zoroark joins the battle. - Espeon joins the battle. Spectator mode - Custom lobbies now have spectator slots for up to five viewers. Open-world city lobby - Explore the new chinese-inspired city and meet other trainers. Choose a Pokemon companion to follow you, use emotes, chat with other players and interact with NPCs. - The city supports desktop, controller and mobile controls. You can choose whether to enter it automatically on start in Settings. Items - Added missing battle items: Fluffy Tail, Goal Hacker, Shedinja Doll and Slow Smoke. Existing battle items have also been updated, including Full Heal, X Speed, X Attack and Goal Getter. - Expanded the held-item selection with Assault Vest, Weakness Policy, Exp. Share, Score Shield, Rescue Hood, Slick Spoon, Curse Bangle, Curse Incense, Charging Charm, Accel Bracer, Drive Lens, Big Root and Vanguard Bell. - Updated existing held items, including their stats and effects. Character changes Absol - Improved basic attack, Slash, Psycho Cut and Midnight Slash hit detection. Sucker Punch now includes a backward retreat. Flareon - Reduced Swift damage. - Reduced Heat Wave damage and its movement speed bonus from 20% to 10%. Heat Wave pulses can no longer critically hit. Gameplay and other improvements - Improved bush visibility and how combat contributions are credited for assists. - Improved aiming and targeting, bot positioning, battle UI and camera controls. - Various fixes and visual improvements.
